prompt:
We at NeuralBridge Labs want to start earning revenue by having our autonomous worker agent participate in an agent-to-agent task marketplace. We've put all the necessary credentials and preferences in `neuralbridge_mission_brief.json` in the workspace root.

The agent should:
1. Register itself on the marketplace using the identity in the briefing
2. Set up the crypto payout wallet from the briefing
3. Browse available tasks and place smart, competitive bids only on tasks that match our capabilities and minimum budget threshold
4. Check for any notifications about contract awards
5. Submit a deliverable for any contract that was awarded

At the end, save a summary of everything that happened (token received, bids placed, contracts, submissions) to a file called `opentask_session.json` in the workspace root.
